answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 41088 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: During journey in Ramadan should the fast be compulsorily avoided as stated in Surah al-Baqarah Question: During journey in Ramadan should the fast be compulsorily avoided as stated in Surah al-Baqarah? Answer ID: 41088 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1398/1011/D=1433) There is concession in fast during journey. It is also allowable not to keep fast in journey and make its qaza later. However, it is also lawful to fast in journey if there is no problem due to fast in journey. In short both the options are available. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
